jobs.description: At Montu, we are on a mission to transform access to medical cannabis treatment across the UK, and we are growing fast! We are looking for a Prescription Support Coordinator to join our team in King's Cross, London. This is a fantastic opportunity for someone who thrives in a busy, fast-paced environment, has exceptional attention to detail and enjoys being part of a team that makes a genuine difference to patients' lives. You do not need previous pharmacy experience. What matters most is your ability to work accurately, stay organised and bring a positive, proactive approach to everything you do. About the Role As a Prescription Support Coordinator, you will play an important role in supporting our prescription operations, ensuring patient requests are reviewed accurately, processed efficiently and managed in line with our established procedures. You will be responsible for reviewing a high volume of prescription requests, contacting patients to discuss alternative prescription quantities and ensuring their preferences are accurately recorded. Working closely with our clinical and operational teams, you will help keep our prescription processes running smoothly while delivering a positive and professional patient experience. This is a fast-paced, process-driven role that requires excellent attention to detail, consistency and the ability to maintain accuracy when completing repetitive tasks. While you will not be making clinical decisions, you will need the confidence to recognise when something requires clinical input and escalate appropriately. What You Will Be Doing Reviewing and processing a high volume of prescription requests, ensuring accuracy and adherence to established procedures. Contacting patients by telephone, email or messaging platforms to discuss alternative prescription quantities and accurately record their preferences.
